metadata.intro: Theoretical physics provides the variational and symmetry-driven engine that governs the mathematical structure of the physical universe. By recasting the laws of nature as extremum principles within a differentiable manifold, the field unifies the discrete logic of quantum mechanics with the continuous trajectories of relativistic geometry. This roadmap navigates from the foundational principle of stationary action to the deep topological invariants and symmetry groups that define the modern quest for a unified field theory.

bridges.classical-mechanics: The variational methods of theoretical physics provide the primary derivation of the Euler-Lagrange equations, bridging Newtonian dynamics and analytical mechanics.
bridges.relativity: The requirement for manifest covariance in the action integral necessitates the use of pseudo-Riemannian geometry, forming the basis of the General Theory of Relativity.
bridges.quantum-physics: The path integral formulation reveals that the classical stationary action is the phase limit of a coherent sum over all possible quantum histories.
bridges.standard-model: The gauge principle, established through the invariance of the Lagrangian density under local transformations, provides the fundamental toolkit for the SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) interaction manifold.

pillars.title: 1. Variational Calculus & Action
pillars.narrative: Developing the mathematical engine of extremum principles, where the trajectories of physical systems are identified as the stationary points of a global action functional.

pillars.title: 2. Symmetry & Conservation
pillars.narrative: Exploring the profound link between the geometric symmetries of space-time and the invariant quantities that govern the history of physical systems.

pillars.title: 3. Hamiltonian Dynamics
pillars.narrative: Recasting the laws of motion into the symplectic geometry of phase space, revealing the canonical structure and poisson algebra that underpin quantum commutation relations.

pillars.title: 4. Field Theoretic Foundations
pillars.narrative: Extending the variational principle to continuous manifolds, defining the lagrangian densities and manifest covariance required for relativistic field interactions.
